security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Collect, deploy and measure agent skills
bundle.longDescription: One library for every agent skill, subagent and slash command you use. Skill Hive scans the agent tools on this machine, imports collections from GitHub or any git URL, finds the right skills for a task, deploys them to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and others without conflicts, and runs evaluations that measure whether a skill's instructions help.
